integrity: All claims rely on the self-contained mathematical argument and an independently implemented finite exact-integer checker. No human or independent scientific audit has occurred; previously published mathematical-morphology identities are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite cyclic \(H\)-by-\(W\) boards with \(H,W\ge4\), equal birth and survival intervals \([0,\varepsilon]\), \(0\le\varepsilon<1/(9HW)\), and the absorbing all-zero state. The cutoff is sufficient but not asserted optimal; larger intervals and exact attraction-basin populations remain unresolved. The original source preprint complete PDF was not available for whole-document priority inspection.
title: Two-update collapse and an exact Lucas orbit census at the zero-field edge of a separable automaton
